verdicts.reason: Both lose the main barrel photo, which shrinks to a tiny thumbnail at the bottom, and the triangle logo becomes a speck beside it. The small em-dash divider is blown up into a thick black bar across the canvas. Around these, huge empty white areas leave the design unrecognisable. A spaces the tagline, thumbnail and logo slightly more evenly. B jams the tagline right on top of the thumbnail and logo, and it is otherwise the same failure.
